port.ask: Serial port the TPG controller appears on (USB virtual COM port of a TPG 36x, or the RS-232 port a TPG 26x is cabled to)
port.help: On Linux /dev/ttyUSB0 or /dev/serial/by-id/usb-FTDI..., on macOS /dev/tty.usbserial-*, on Windows COM3. The TPG 36x USB port is an FTDI chip; install the FTDI VCP driver if no port appears.

baud.ask: Baud rate set on the controller (BAU parameter; 9600 is the factory default)
